text: The author of the sutras stated that the authority of the Mantras and Ayurveda is derived from the authority of the Apta (the spiritually realized person) (Gau. Su. 2/1/67). Similarly, Acharya Udayana, world-renowned for his fame and having mastered the vast depths of the paths of logic, also states in the fourth chapter of the Nyaya-Kusumanjali: "Definition is precise determination, and the status of a knower is established by that."
